Hi Laura,

Thanks again — contract is fully executed on our side (attached). Our Exec sponsor and product teams want a concise mutual action plan embedded into the post-signature implementation plan so we have clear owners, acceptance criteria, and a canary rollout window. High level asks from our side:

- A 60–90 day onramp that includes a 2-week canary in production with rollback criteria.
- Training for 12 engineers + 3 product owners (we prefer live remote sessions).
- Confirmation of any Private/VPC requirements and KMS controls (we're evaluating keys).

Samira — thanks and congrats. Glad to have GreenForest live with Redwood. Attached is our working draft: GreenForest-MAP-v1.xlsx and the canary runbook (GFH-canary-runbook.pdf). High-level proposal below (we can iterate in a short call):

Phase A — Prep (Week 0–2)
- Ownership: Laura Bennett (Account Lead) / Rafael Mendes (Platform Eng)
- Activities: access provisioning, security questionnaire completion, baseline eval prompt set (we'll propose 150 prompts), test harness set-up
- Deliverable: Acceptance criteria doc and signed access matrix

Phase B — Pilot + Training (Week 3–4)
- Ownership: Monica Patel (Customer Success) / Vivek Kulkarni (Customer Ops)
- Activities: 2x 90-minute live training sessions (engineers + product), run pilot workload on Dedicated pool, collect eval metrics
- Deliverable: Training feedback, pilot metrics dashboard

Phase C — Canary (Week 5–6)
- Ownership: Rafael Mendes / Backend SRE (Rafael)
- Activities: 2-week canary at 5–10% traffic routing to Redwood Dedicated; gates at 24h and 7d; KV cache warm-up; automated rollback if P50 latency > 350ms or error rate > 0.5%
- Deliverable: Canary runbook sign-off or rollback execution report

Phase D — Gradual Migration & Handoff (Week 7–12)
- Ownership: Monica + Laura
- Activities: Incremental allocation, training follow-ups, runbook handoff, run a final acceptance test using the eval prompts
- Deliverable: Production acceptance and runbook transfer

I've included suggested dates in the attached XLSX (May 23 kick-off for Phase A). Please review the acceptance metrics in the Eval tab and suggest any add/changes. Two asks from us: 1) confirmation on KMS/VPC constraints; 2) sign-off on canary gating thresholds by EOD May 24 so we can lock resource reservations.

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Quick technical notes on canary gates (adding here so the eval tab is consistent):

- Canary window: recommend 10 business days (two business weeks) to get stable sampling across peak/off-peak.
- Metrics: p50/p90 latency, token cost delta, rejection/error rate, and output-quality drift (we'll use the 150-prompt eval set).
- Rollback immediate triggers: sustained error > 0.5% for > 10 minutes OR p90 latency > 600ms for > 15 minutes.
- Fallback plan: automatic re-route to hosted fallback model + incident channel to GreenForest engineers.

I'll attach a short runbook for the rollback steps in the canary PDF. Rafael
